title: Made query-engine trace docs easier to navigate
points: The Explore the trace cards now start closed so readers choose which stage to open.

The stage picker is now a true vertical accordion: opening Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, or Verify expands the real detail inside that stage row while the remaining stages keep their reading order below it.
The redundant second stage-detail navigation layer was removed so the accordion is the primary way to inspect Plan, Retrieve, Compute, Write, and Verify.
